name: Continue with Recovery Code
description: Collects one TOTP recovery code for an already identified durable identity when the authenticator is unavailable.

web.implementation: Recovery-code sign-in surface not yet implemented.

mobile.implementation: Presentation shell exists with the canonical recovery-code field and actions, but verification remains a pending placeholder and status:recovery-error is not yet exposed.

notes: This surface is entered only after a primary credential has produced an outstanding MFA requirement.
A rejected recovery code remains on this view and must not disclose whether the code was invalid, already consumed, or otherwise unavailable.
